conversations.title: Leaving a Friend's Party
conversations.description: Saying goodbye to a friend after a fun evening party.

messages.text: Grazie di essere venuto alla mia festa!
messages.english: Thanks for coming to my party!

choices.text: Grazie a te per l'invito. Mi sono divertito molto.
choices.english: Thanks to you for the invitation. I had a lot of fun.
choices.feedback: Perfect way to thank the host.

choices.text: Voglio comprare tre chili di mele rosse e dolci.
choices.english: I want to buy three kilos of red and sweet apples.
choices.feedback: This is for a grocery store.

choices.text: Il treno per Roma parte dal binario numero quattro.
choices.english: The train to Rome leaves from platform number four.
choices.feedback: This is about a train station.

messages.text: Mi fa piacere. C'è ancora molta torta se vuoi.
messages.english: I'm glad. There's still plenty of cake if you want.

choices.text: No grazie, sono davvero pieno. Devo andare ora.
choices.english: No thanks, I'm really full. I have to go now.
choices.feedback: Politely declining and stating you need to leave.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno? Ho bisogno di lavarmi le mani.
choices.english: Where is the bathroom? I need to wash my hands.
choices.feedback: You should be leaving, not looking for the bathroom.

choices.text: Questo vestito nero è troppo stretto per me.
choices.english: This black dress is too tight for me.

messages.text: Va bene. Hai tutto? Giacca e chiavi?
messages.english: Alright. Do you have everything? Jacket and keys?

choices.text: Sì, ho preso tutto. È stata una serata bellissima.
choices.english: Yes, I took everything. It was a beautiful evening.
choices.feedback: Confirming you have your things and complimenting the evening.

choices.text: Il mio gatto mangia solo pesce fresco di mattina.
choices.english: My cat only eats fresh fish in the morning.

choices.text: Vorrei un tavolo vicino alla finestra, per favore.
choices.english: I would like a table near the window, please.

messages.text: Sono d'accordo. Dobbiamo rivederci presto.
messages.english: I agree. We must see each other again soon.

choices.text: Sicuramente! Ti chiamo la settimana prossima.
choices.english: Definitely! I'll call you next week.
choices.feedback: Agreeing to meet again and suggesting a follow-up.

choices.text: Ho perso il mio passaporto in questo ufficio.
choices.english: I lost my passport in this office.
choices.feedback: This is an emergency at an office.

choices.text: Il sole è molto forte oggi, porto gli occhiali.
choices.english: The sun is very strong today, I'm wearing glasses.

messages.text: Perfetto. Salutami tanto la tua famiglia.
messages.english: Perfect. Say hi to your family for me.

choices.text: Lo farò senz'altro. Buona serata e grazie ancora!
choices.english: I certainly will. Good evening and thanks again!
choices.feedback: Promising to pass on the greetings and thanking again.

choices.text: Quanto costa un biglietto per il museo d'arte?
choices.english: How much does a ticket for the art museum cost?
choices.feedback: This is asking for a price.

choices.text: La mia macchina è parcheggiata sotto l'albero.
choices.english: My car is parked under the tree.

messages.text: Buona serata anche a te. Fai attenzione per strada.
messages.english: Good evening to you too. Be careful on the road.

choices.text: Tranquillo, vado a piedi. Ci vediamo presto!
choices.english: Don't worry, I'm going on foot. See you soon!
choices.feedback: Reassuring the host and saying see you soon.

choices.text: Ho bisogno di una medicina per il mal di testa.
choices.english: I need a medicine for a headache.

choices.text: Il mio cane corre sempre veloce nel grande parco.
choices.english: My dog always runs fast in the large park.

messages.text: Ciao ciao! Stammi bene.
messages.english: Bye bye! Take care.

choices.text: Ciao! A presto!
choices.english: Bye! See you soon!

choices.text: Dov'è la banca?
choices.english: Where is the bank?

choices.text: Voglio del pane.
choices.english: I want some bread.

messages.text: Aspetta! Hai dimenticato il tuo ombrello qui.
messages.english: Wait! You forgot your umbrella here.

choices.text: Oh, grazie mille! Meno male che me lo hai detto.
choices.english: Oh, thanks a lot! Good thing you told me.
choices.feedback: Expressing relief and thanking for the reminder.

choices.text: Il mio computer è rotto e non si accende più.
choices.english: My computer is broken and doesn't turn on anymore.

choices.text: Vorrei una camera doppia con vista sul mare.
choices.english: I would like a double room with a sea view.

messages.text: Figurati. Ora puoi andare, piove un po'.
messages.english: No worries. Now you can go, it's raining a little.

choices.text: Infatti. Buonanotte e a domani allora!
choices.english: Indeed. Goodnight and see you tomorrow then!
choices.feedback: Closing with a goodnight and mentioning tomorrow.

choices.text: Ho fame e voglio mangiare una pizza grande.
choices.english: I'm hungry and I want to eat a large pizza.
choices.feedback: You just said you were full.

choices.text: La fermata dell'autobus è proprio qui vicino.
choices.english: The bus stop is right here nearby.
choices.feedback: This is about a bus stop.

messages.text: Buonanotte. A domani in ufficio!
messages.english: Goodnight. See you tomorrow at the office!

choices.text: A domani! Ciao!
choices.english: See you tomorrow! Bye!

choices.text: Il conto, grazie.
choices.english: The bill, please.

choices.text: Quanto costa?
choices.english: How much is it?

conversations.title: Ending a Phone Call with a Relative
conversations.description: Saying goodbye to a relative over the phone after a long chat.

messages.text: È stato bello sentirti, ma ora devo proprio andare.
messages.english: It was nice hearing from you, but now I really must go.

choices.text: Hai ragione, abbiamo parlato per un'ora intera.
choices.english: You're right, we've talked for a whole hour.
choices.feedback: Acknowledging the length of the call.

choices.text: Mi scusi, dove posso comprare dei francobolli?
choices.english: Excuse me, where can I buy some stamps?
choices.feedback: This is for a post office.

choices.text: Il mio aereo parte tra circa quaranta minuti.
choices.english: My plane leaves in about forty minutes.

messages.text: Il tempo vola quando chiacchieriamo insieme!
messages.english: Time flies when we chat together!

choices.text: Vero! Allora ci sentiamo presto, va bene?
choices.english: True! So we'll talk soon, alright?
choices.feedback: Agreeing and suggesting a future call.

choices.text: Voglio ordinare una pasta al forno calda.
choices.english: I want to order a hot baked pasta.

choices.text: La mia televisione non ha più il segnale.
choices.english: My television no longer has a signal.

messages.text: Certo. Magari ci sentiamo domenica prossima.
messages.english: Sure. Maybe we'll talk next Sunday.

choices.text: Perfetto, domenica pomeriggio sono a casa.
choices.english: Perfect, Sunday afternoon I'm at home.
choices.feedback: Confirming availability for the next call.

choices.text: Dov'è il parcheggio per le macchine elettriche?
choices.english: Where is the parking for electric cars?

choices.text: Oggi voglio leggere un libro molto lungo.
choices.english: Today I want to read a very long book.
choices.feedback: This is about a personal plan.

messages.text: D'accordo. Salutami tutti a casa tua.
messages.english: Agreed. Say hi to everyone at your house.

choices.text: Certamente, lo farò. E tu saluta gli zii.
choices.english: Certainly, I will. And you say hi to the aunt and uncle.
choices.feedback: Passing on greetings to other relatives.

choices.text: Quanto costano queste scarpe da ginnastica?
choices.english: How much do these sneakers cost?

choices.text: Il mio cane ha bisogno di una visita.
choices.english: My dog needs a check-up.

messages.text: Sarà fatto. Mi raccomando, mangia bene!
messages.english: Will do. Please, eat well!

choices.text: Non ti preoccupare, cucino sempre cose sane.
choices.english: Don't worry, I always cook healthy things.
choices.feedback: Reassuring the relative about your health.

choices.text: C'è un ufficio postale qui in questa via?
choices.english: Is there a post office here in this street?

choices.text: La mia valigia è troppo pesante per me.
choices.english: My suitcase is too heavy for me.

messages.text: Bravo. Ti mando un messaggio stasera.
messages.english: Good. I'll send you a message tonight.

choices.text: Va bene, lo leggerò volentieri. A presto!
choices.english: Alright, I'll gladly read it. See you soon!
choices.feedback: Acknowledging the future message and saying goodbye.

choices.text: Vorrei un gelato alla crema e cioccolato.
choices.english: I would like a cream and chocolate gelato.
choices.feedback: This is for a gelato shop.

choices.text: Il mio volo ha un ritardo di tre ore.
choices.english: My flight has a three-hour delay.

messages.text: Un abbraccio forte. Ciao caro!
messages.english: A big hug. Bye dear!

choices.text: Un abbraccio anche a te. Ciao ciao!
choices.english: A hug to you too. Bye bye!
choices.feedback: Returning the hug and saying goodbye.

choices.text: Quanto costa il pane?
choices.english: How much is the bread?

choices.text: Dov'è l'uscita ora?
choices.english: Where is the exit now?

messages.text: Dimenticavo! Buon compleanno a tua sorella!
messages.english: I forgot! Happy birthday to your sister!

choices.text: Grazie, glielo dirò stasera alla festa.
choices.english: Thanks, I'll tell her tonight at the party.
choices.feedback: Thanking and explaining when the message will be passed.

choices.text: Il mio telefono è scarico e non funziona.
choices.english: My phone is out of battery and doesn't work.

choices.text: Vorrei prenotare un tavolo per sei persone.
choices.english: I would like to book a table for six people.

messages.text: Ottimo. Allora buona festa a tutti voi!
messages.english: Great. Then have a good party to you all!

choices.text: Grazie mille! A risentirci allora. Ciao!
choices.english: Thanks a lot! Talk to you again then. Bye!
choices.feedback: A final goodbye for a phone call.

choices.text: Il tempo oggi è brutto e piove molto.
choices.english: The weather today is bad and it rains a lot.

choices.text: La mia borsa è nel treno per Milano.
choices.english: My bag is on the train to Milan.
choices.feedback: This is about a lost bag.

messages.text: Ciao ciao, a risentirci!
messages.english: Bye bye, talk to you again!

choices.text: Ciao!
choices.english: Bye!

choices.text: Prego.
choices.english: You're welcome.

choices.text: Scusi.
choices.english: Excuse me.

conversations.title: Casual Encounter on the Street
conversations.description: Saying goodbye to an acquaintance after bumping into them on the street.

messages.text: È stato un piacere rivederti per caso!
messages.english: It was a pleasure to see you again by chance!

choices.text: Anche per me! Che bella sorpresa oggi.
choices.english: For me too! What a nice surprise today.
choices.feedback: Returning the sentiment and commenting on the surprise.

choices.text: Vorrei due chili di pasta fresca, grazie.
choices.english: I would like two kilos of fresh pasta, thanks.
choices.feedback: This is for a pasta shop.

choices.text: Il mio hotel è vicino alla piazza grande.
choices.english: My hotel is near the large square.

messages.text: Infatti. Ora dove stai andando di bello?
messages.english: Indeed. Now where are you going that's nice?

choices.text: Vado in biblioteca a studiare un po'.
choices.english: I'm going to the library to study a bit.

choices.text: Il mio cane ha mangiato la mia scarpa.
choices.english: My dog ate my shoe.
choices.feedback: This is about a pet problem.

choices.text: Preferisco il tè freddo al caffè caldo.
choices.english: I prefer cold tea to hot coffee.

messages.text: Buono studio allora. Io vado a fare la spesa.
messages.english: Happy studying then. I'm going to do the shopping.

choices.text: D'accordo. Allora non ti rubo altro tempo.
choices.english: Agreed. Then I won't take any more of your time.
choices.feedback: Politely ending the conversation to let the host go.

choices.text: Dov'è l'ufficio informazioni del turismo?
choices.english: Where is the tourist information office?

choices.text: La mia televisione è troppo vecchia ora.
choices.english: My television is too old now.

messages.text: Non preoccuparti. Ci vediamo un giorno per un caffè?
messages.english: Don't worry. Shall we see each other one day for a coffee?

choices.text: Volentieri! Ti scrivo io su WhatsApp.
choices.english: Gladly! I'll write to you on WhatsApp.
choices.feedback: Accepting the invitation and suggesting a contact method.

choices.text: Ho perso le mie chiavi nel grande parco.
choices.english: I lost my keys in the large park.

choices.text: Il sole è caldissimo questo pomeriggio.
choices.english: The sun is very hot this afternoon.

messages.text: Ottima idea. Aspetto il tuo messaggio.
messages.english: Great idea. I'll wait for your message.

choices.text: Certamente. Allora buona giornata e a presto!
choices.english: Certainly. Then have a good day and see you soon!
choices.feedback: Saying have a good day and see you soon.

choices.text: Quanto costa un chilo di pane bianco?
choices.english: How much does a kilo of white bread cost?
choices.feedback: This is asking for a price.

choices.text: La mia macchina è nel parcheggio rosso.
choices.english: My car is in the red parking lot.

messages.text: Buona giornata anche a te. Ciao!
messages.english: Have a good day to you too. Bye!

choices.text: Ciao ciao! A più tardi!
choices.english: Bye bye! See you later!

choices.text: Vorrei un succo.
choices.english: I'd like a juice.

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno?
choices.english: Where is the bathroom?

messages.text: Ah, aspetta! Salutami tanto i tuoi colleghi.
messages.english: Ah, wait! Say hi to your colleagues for me.

choices.text: Lo farò senz'altro. Saranno contenti.
choices.english: I certainly will. They'll be happy.
choices.feedback: Promising to pass on the greetings.

choices.text: Il mio gatto dorme sempre sul divano.
choices.english: My cat always sleeps on the sofa.

choices.text: Voglio comprare un giornale sportivo.
choices.english: I want to buy a sports newspaper.

messages.text: Bene. Allora ci sentiamo presto su WhatsApp.
messages.english: Good. Then we'll talk soon on WhatsApp.

choices.text: D'accordo. Buona continuazione e ciao!
choices.english: Agreed. Enjoy the rest of your day and bye!
choices.feedback: A polite way to end the encounter.

choices.text: La mia bicicletta è rotta da stamattina.
choices.english: My bicycle is broken since this morning.

choices.text: Ho bisogno di un dottore molto bravo.
choices.english: I need a very good doctor.

messages.text: Ciao! Stammi bene e a presto.
messages.english: Bye! Take care and see you soon.

choices.text: Ciao! Anche a te! A presto!
choices.english: Bye! To you too! See you soon!

choices.text: Il vento soffia.
choices.english: The wind blows.

choices.text: Quanto costa?
choices.english: How much?

messages.text: Ciao ciao!
messages.english: Bye bye!

choices.text: Ciao!
choices.english: Bye!

choices.text: Prego.
choices.english: You're welcome.

choices.text: Niente.
choices.english: Nothing.

conversations.title: Formal Goodbye at a Shop
conversations.description: Saying goodbye formally to a shopkeeper after a purchase.

messages.text: Ecco il suo resto e lo scontrino. Grazie mille.
messages.english: Here is your change and the receipt. Thank you very much.

choices.text: Grazie a lei. Posso avere anche un sacchetto?
choices.english: Thank you. Can I also have a bag?
choices.feedback: Thanking the shopkeeper and asking for a bag.

choices.text: Voglio prenotare un volo per la Sicilia.
choices.english: I want to book a flight for Sicily.
choices.feedback: This is for a travel agency.

choices.text: Il mio cane mangia solo carne di manzo.
choices.english: My dog only eats beef meat.

messages.text: Certamente, eccolo qui. Serve altro?
messages.english: Certainly, here it is. Do you need anything else?

choices.text: No, grazie. Sono a posto così. Arrivederci.
choices.english: No, thanks. I'm all set. Goodbye.
choices.feedback: Declining further help and saying a formal goodbye.

choices.text: Dov'è l'ingresso della stazione centrale?
choices.english: Where is the entrance to the central station?

choices.text: La mia televisione è accesa in camera.
choices.english: My television is on in the room.

messages.text: Arrivederci e buona giornata!
messages.english: Goodbye and have a good day!

choices.text: Grazie, buona giornata anche a lei!
choices.english: Thanks, have a good day to you too!

choices.text: Il mio computer ha lo schermo sporco.
choices.english: My computer has a dirty screen.
choices.feedback: This is about a tech issue.

choices.text: Vorrei un gelato alla fragola e limone.
choices.english: I would like a strawberry and lemon gelato.
choices.feedback: This is for a gelato shop.

messages.text: Torni presto a trovarci, abbiamo spesso sconti.
messages.english: Come back soon to visit us, we often have discounts.

choices.text: Molto bene, lo farò senz'altro. A presto!
choices.english: Very well, I certainly will. See you soon!
choices.feedback: Agreeing to return and saying see you soon.

choices.text: Il mio volo parte alle sei di mattina.
choices.english: My flight leaves at six in the morning.

choices.text: La borsa è sul tavolo della cucina.
choices.english: The bag is on the kitchen table.
choices.feedback: This is about a location of a bag.

messages.text: Le auguro un buon fine settimana.
messages.english: I wish you a good weekend.

choices.text: Grazie, buon fine settimana anche a lei!
choices.english: Thanks, good weekend to you too!

choices.text: Quanto costa questo vestito rosso qui?
choices.english: How much does this red dress cost here?
choices.feedback: This is asking for a price.

choices.text: La mia macchina è nel parcheggio blu.
choices.english: My car is in the blue parking lot.

messages.text: Grazie. Buona serata e arrivederci.
messages.english: Thanks. Good evening and goodbye.

choices.text: Buona serata, arrivederci!
choices.english: Good evening, goodbye!

choices.text: Dov'è il bagno?
choices.english: Where is the bathroom?

choices.text: Voglio del tè.
choices.english: I want some tea.

messages.text: Mi scusi! Ha dimenticato l'ombrello sul banco.
messages.english: Excuse me! You forgot the umbrella on the counter.

choices.text: Oh, mi scusi lei. Grazie mille per l'aiuto.
choices.english: Oh, excuse me. Thanks a lot for the help.

choices.text: Il mio computer è rotto e non va.
choices.english: My computer is broken and doesn't work.

choices.text: Vorrei una camera singola con doccia.
choices.english: I would like a single room with a shower.

messages.text: Figurati, nessun problema. Buon proseguimento!
messages.english: No worries, no problem. Have a good rest of the day!

choices.text: Grazie, buon proseguimento anche a lei. Ciao!
choices.english: Thanks, have a good rest of the day to you too. Bye!
choices.feedback: A polite and natural response to a formal wish.

choices.text: La mia pizza è fredda e non mi piace.
choices.english: My pizza is cold and I don't like it.

choices.text: Il vento oggi è forte in questa città.
choices.english: The wind today is strong in this city.

messages.text: Buona serata ancora. Arrivederci!
messages.english: Good evening again. Goodbye!

choices.text: Arrivederci e grazie di tutto!
choices.english: Goodbye and thanks for everything!

choices.text: Quanto costa ora?
choices.english: How much is it now?

choices.text: Dov'è l'uscita?
choices.english: Where is the exit?

messages.text: Arrivederci!
messages.english: Goodbye!

choices.text: Arrivederci!
choices.english: Goodbye!

choices.text: Prego.
choices.english: You're welcome.

choices.text: Scusi.
choices.english: Excuse me.
